branded.why: The Laughing Cow, the processed cheese wedge known around the world for a century.

about.text: An industrial processed cheese from Fromageries Bel, made from a blend of cheeses such as Emmental, Comté, Gouda and Cheddar. It was formerly sold as crème de gruyère.

sources.text: The processed blend, the brand and the company's history, from this article.
